review_improvement: Replaces unsafe guessed mirror commands with a stable-identity, one-member-only degraded/rebuild lifecycle and surfaces the unresolved destructive member count.
independent_technical_reasoning: RAID1 can technically mirror across more than two members, but capacity, rebuild behavior and fault tolerance differ from the common two-member case. Because the source fixes four devices while the proposed automation assumes two, device count materially changes the tested topology and cannot be inferred before mkfs or fault injection.
